### Bible Pathways - Mar. 9, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-mar-9-2008-11570130.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 25:14-16
Points:
- God requires absolute honesty, justice, and integrity in commercial and personal transactions.
- Cheating, manipulation, and using unequal standards are detestable practices in God's sight.
- Living under the law of Christ means practicing the Golden Rule and actively seeking the neighbor's good.
- Believers must preserve their Christian witness by refusing deceit, repaying debts, and acting with uprightness.
- Experiencing mistreatment from others offers an occasion to demonstrate God's patient and forgiving love.
